/<!-- Thanks for contributing to e4! Keep PRs focused; explain what and why. -->

## What & why
<!-- What does this change, and why is it needed? Link any issue: Closes #NNN -->


## Type of change
- [ ] `feat` — new command / hook / capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` — tooling, cleanup, no behavior change

## Checklist
- [ ] **No personal/private data** — no DailyLogs/Projects/Archive content, no `User/profile.md` or `coding-standards.md`, no work/company project names
- [ ] **No secrets** — no `.env`, tokens, keys, connection strings, or internal hostnames
- [ ] Commit messages follow **Conventional Commits** (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …)
- [ ] If I added/changed a command, I signed `commands/e4/CONTRIBUTORS.md`
- [ ] Any hook script kept **LF** endings; I tested it with `bash` + `python3`
- [ ] Python stays **stdlib-only** and prints no non-ASCII to stdout (Windows cp1252)
- [ ] I reviewed my diff and it contains only what this PR describes
